reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness theme plugin that adds a mist-blue visual layer, optional cloud animation, frosted-glass styling, persistent intensity controls, and a quick toggle command.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可切换的雾蓝主题、云雾动效、毛玻璃界面效果以及可持久化的浓度调节功能。
summaries.en: Adds a switchable mist-blue theme to DeepSeek Harness with cloud animation, frosted-glass interface styling, and persistent intensity controls.

capabilities: Registers a client-side mist-blue visual theme for DeepSeek Harness
Applies scoped CSS overlays, cloud animation, and frosted-glass effects to interface elements
Adds a settings toggle, intensity slider, and /misttheme command
Persists theme state and intensity in browser localStorage
